name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
description: A console window that types out commands line by line, shows logs, success and error lines, and snaps older lines off the top as the buffer fills.
useWhen: Demoing a CLI tool install sequence (package install, scaffold, build output).
Showing an AI agent or script executing a multi-step task in a terminal session.
A developer tool launch video needs the authentic feel of commands running and output streaming.
avoidWhen: You only need to type a single short string: use typewriter, which is lighter and pairs with any layout.
The code should be shown as a formatted, highlighted editor window: use glass-code-block.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Lines
variables.description: JSON array of lines: [{"text", "type": "command" | "log" | "success" | "error", "delay": frames before the line starts (default 8), "pause": extra frames to hold after it (lines ending in ... hold 18)}].
variables.default: [{"text":"npm run build","type":"command","delay":0},{"text":"Resolving dependencies...","type":"log","delay":6},{"text":"> my-app@1.0.0 build","type":"log","delay":4},{"text":"> next build","type":"log","delay":4},{"text":"Compiling...","type":"log","delay":12},{"text":"Compiled successfully in 4.2s","type":"success","delay":14},{"text":"Generating static pages (24/24)","type":"log","delay":10},{"text":"Build completed without errors","type":"success","delay":12}]

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Window title in the title bar.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Terminal text size in design pixels (the window scales to fit the frame).
